project_name: Tríade POA - Sistema Financeiro Inteligente & WhatsApp Business Concierge

theme_strategy.archetype: Archetype 5: Luxury & Executive Precision (Deep Obsidian, Warm Sandstone, Imperial Gold, Brazilian Emerald)
theme_strategy.description: Executive high-trust corporate finance workspace for Tríade Porto Alegre. Marries Swiss brutalist discipline with warm architectural bronze and Brazilian executive dignity. Avoids generic blue fintech clichés, sterile grey wireframes, and eye-burning neon gradients.

rules: Never use pure Inter regular for main titles; give them weight, letter tracking, or uppercase hierarchy
All numeric financial tables and currency displays MUST use monospace font family for column alignment
Use explicit contrast on badges: dark badges with colored text and subtle 1px border

layout_and_grids.structure: Responsive Executive Dashboard (Sidebar + Sticky Header + Multi-tab Financial Workspace)

sidebar.position: fixed left-0 top-0 bottom-0 z-40 hidden lg:flex flex-col border-r border-border/40 bg-surface_base/95 backdrop-blur-xl
sidebar.header: Tríade Porto Alegre logo lockup + active company badge
sidebar.footer: WhatsApp Gateway status monitor (Explicitly unconfigured/disconnected state by default), current user & Porto Alegre business hours

header.style: sticky top-0 z-30 px-6 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-border/40 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl
header.controls: Period selector (Mês/Ano), Quick New Launch CTA, Theme Toggle, Spreadsheet Sync Status indicator

bento_grid_rules.mode: MODE B: High Density Financial Grid
rules: Containers with borders must use internal padding p-5 or p-6
KPI metric cards on top (4 columns on lg:grid-cols-4)
DRE Gerencial uses collapsible tree rows (Receita Bruta -> Deduções -> Receita Líquida -> Custos -> Margem de Contribuição -> Despesas Fixas -> EBITDA/LAIR -> Lucro Líquido)
Direct children in grids for framer-motion compatibility

features: Faithful hierarchy from TRIADE_ERP_FINANCEIRO sheet 'DRE Gerencial'
Columns: Conta Contábil, Jan-Dez + Acumulado Anual + % Vertical
Visual subtotal rows with gold or emerald accent highlights
Toggle between Monthly breakdown and Quarterly view
Inline quick audit indicator showing formula provenance
Filter comprovantes by Month (Jan a Dez), Year, and Plano de Contas Category
OCR Extraction simulation + actual upload: reads Valor, Data, Favorecido, CNPJ, Categoria sugerida
Status badge: 'Lançado no DRE', 'Pendente de Conferência', 'Em Análise'
Thumbnail & receipt lightbox preview modal with download & link to ledger
Dropzone for receipt images/PDFs with visual drag-and-drop feedback
Honest status: Disconnected / Aguardando Configuração de Webhook da Meta Business Cloud API
DO NOT fake connected state. Show clear step-by-step setup guide with Phone Number ID, WABA ID, Permanent Token
Live Interactive Sandbox: Test sending expense message e.g. 'Almoço cliente R$ 145,90 com cartão' or uploading a photo receipt
Bot response preview showing automatic categorization into Plano de Contas & spreadsheet row insertion
Activity feed of incoming WhatsApp events
Health Score 0-100 calculated from Ponto de Equilíbrio, Margem Líquida, and Runway
Break-even chart (Custos Fixos vs Margem de Contribuição vs Ponto de Equilíbrio)
Executive AI Diagnostic Insights: alerts on expense spikes, recommendation for cash reserves, operating leverage analysis
Simulador de Cenários (impact of +10% revenue vs -15% fixed expenses)
Export live data to standard Excel matching the Tríade POA structure
Import new .xlsx or .csv to overwrite or merge transactions
Direct download link to original template: TRIADE_ERP_FINANCEIRO FINAL PADRÃO (2).xlsx

receipt_sample_3.description: Financial accounting spreadsheet documentation with pen

porto_alegre_location.description: Modern architecture sunlight interior in Porto Alegre Rio Grande do Sul

micro_interactions.button_primary: bg-[#D9A33E] hover:bg-[#C28F2F] text-black font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-[#D9A33E]/20 transition-all active:scale-[0.98]
micro_interactions.button_secondary: bg-surface_card hover:bg-surface_card_hover text-foreground border border-border/50 transition-all
micro_interactions.toast_feedback: Use sonner for success toasts: 'Lançamento registrado na DRE', 'Comprovante indexado com sucesso', 'Sincronização concluída'

general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility_test_ids: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, filter selects, and data rows MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='dre-table-row', data-testid='upload-receipt-btn', data-testid='whatsapp-test-send-btn')
general_ui_ux_guidelines.transparency_ban: No transparent dropdown backgrounds or invisible floating navbars. Always use backdrop-blur with minimum 85% opacity or solid surface background to guarantee contrast
general_ui_ux_guidelines.language: 100% Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). Use correct Brazilian financial terms: DRE Gerencial, Margem de Contribuição, Ponto de Equilíbrio, Pró-Labore, Despesas Operacionais, EBITDA, Comprovantes Fiscais, Plano de Contas
general_ui_ux_guidelines.whatsapp_integrity: Credentials are not provided by default, so DO NOT simulate an already connected verified WhatsApp Business token. Explicitly show 'Status: Desconectado / Modo de Demonstração & Configuração de Webhook' with a fully functional simulator that displays how the webhook processes text and receipt images into the spreadsheet
